title: mcp-publisher fails with 'NPM package is missing required mcpName field' although package.json has it
symptoms: NPM package '@scope/name' is missing required 'mcpName' field
The latest version on npm shows the correct mcpName, but publishing still fails
cause: The registry verifies npm ownership by reading mcpName from the package.json of the exact npm version named in server.json under packages[].version, and it must equal the server name. That version is separate from the top-level server version, so pointing at an older npm release that predates mcpName fails.
fix: Publish an npm version that contains mcpName, set packages[].version in server.json to that version, then publish to the registry.
affected: Official MCP Registry, npm packages, as of 2026-10
